body.note: Packet proposal followed. The chapter fixes notation used from the convolution and conditional-density chapters on, and uses product-measures and the uniform moments of w02b-p15-001; the lead may prefer directly after parts/p15/probability-spaces-and-random-variables-w02b-p15-001 (p15.tex line 19).

patch_requests: work/waves/w02ca/patches/w02ca-p15-001.json (8 requests): after thm:p15-expectation-law-integral (C016 name and four-step method); end of def:p15-integrable-functions (C006, all four notations); two replacements in annex:p15.radon-nikodym-examples (radon-nikodym C018); after thm:p15-holder-integral (C012); after thm:p15-expectation-bounds (C017); after def:p15-lp-convergence pointing to thm:p15-w02c-p15-005-ae-measure (C009); r5: replacement of the sigma-finite assembly paragraph in annex:p15.lebesgue-decomposition (radon-nikodym C011).

r8 (b2): request 9, insert_after the last sentence of def:p15-integration-next-boundary in handbook/parts/p15/integration-expectation.tex: places Durrett's Exercises 1.5.5, 1.5.8, 1.5.10, 1.6.1-1.6.7, 1.6.9-1.6.14, Example 1.6.12, the notation of pp. 23-24 and the four-step method of pp. 18, 32 at their proving labels (C020, with C004-C008, C014, C017, C019). Same anchor as request 3 of w02ca-p15-005.json; apply after it, and only with the routing of both chapters.

r9 (b1): request 10, insert_after the end of thm:p15-jensen-integral in handbook/parts/p15/integration-expectation.tex: attaches the two-point illustration and Figure 1.6 (def:p15-w02c-p15-005-jensen-direction), the special cases (thm:p15-w02c-p15-005-jensen-special) and the hypothesis boundaries (sec:p15-w02c-p15-001-jensen-hypotheses) to the on-route theorem (C014). Apply only with the routing of both chapters (requests 1-2 of w02ca-p15-005.json).
existing_treatments_not_listed: def:p15-probability-density (convolution-gamma-normal.tex) already writes lambda^d with lambda^1 = lambda; adopted here.

thm:p15-w02b-p15-042-diffeomorphism and thm:p15-affine-lebesgue: Jacobian substitution rules, distinguished from Durrett's change of variables formula in def:p15-w02c-p15-001-change-of-variables-name.

handbook/annex/p15/inductive-logic-and-confirmation-w02b-p15-029.tex line 1213 uses the phrase 'the change of variables formula' with a Jacobian, i.e. for the diffeomorphism rule, not Durrett's thm. 1.6.9; the owner may wish to cite thm:p15-w02b-p15-042-diffeomorphism there.

Several later chapters write integrals with an infinite limit (e.g. characteristic-function-criteria-and-moments.tex line 116, bayes-factor-computation.tex line 403, central-limit-theorems.tex line 402); Durrett's case (b) does not cover them, and the convention says so; thm:p15-w02c-p15-001-interval-limits gives when such a limit equals the half-line Lebesgue integral.

thm:p15-w02c-p15-005-ae-measure (handbook/parts/p15/measure-integration-and-product-constructions-w02c-p15-005.tex line 123, packet w02ca-p15-005) already proves the a.e. versus in-measure comparison for integration-expectation C009; linked, not duplicated.

thm:p15-stieltjes-construction (measure-extension.tex) supplies mu_G for case (c); the annex of thm:p15-expectation-law-integral contains the point-mass integral identity for probability measures, generalized in part (1) of thm:p15-w02c-p15-001-counting-sums.

r5: thm:p15-w02c-p15-005-monotone-lower, -signed-series, -jensen-direction, -jensen-several, -supporting-affine, -jensen-equality, -am-gm, -chebyshev-displays, -chebyshev-sharp, -no-lower, -positive-lower, -no-dominator (handbook/parts/p15/measure-integration-and-product-constructions-w02c-p15-005.tex, packet w02ca-p15-005): close integration-expectation C004, C005, C014, C017 (rest) and C019 once routed; linked, not duplicated.

r5: thm:p15-w02c-p15-003-block-integrals and thm:p15-w02c-p15-003-trace-generation (handbook/parts/p15/measure-integration-and-product-constructions-w02c-p15-003.tex, packet w02ca-p15-003): the trace-integral identification needed by radon-nikodym C011; cited by patch request 8.

r5: thm:p15-w02c-p15-007-restricted-integral (handbook/parts/p15/conditioning-independence-and-information-w02c-p15-007.tex, packet w02ca-p15-007) with patch requests in work/waves/w02ca/patches/w02ca-p15-007.json: addresses conditional-expectation C002 (readonly unit here).
proposed_decisions: lambda^d: same glyph and role as the registered row of P15 convolution-gamma-normal (finite product Borel Lebesgue measure); used with that meaning.
R^d (calligraphic): Durrett's name for Borel sets, used only inside the report of his notation cases; registered as a scoped source notation, bridged to B(R^d) of def:p15-borel-sets.
mu(dy): same integration-notation pattern as K(y,dx) of P15 regular-conditional-laws.
g, c_n, S_N, L and tilde h, U_U: local to their theorem and proof.

i_A: Durrett's letter for the infimum in thm. 1.6.4 (p. 29); same quantity as the registered c_A of P15 integration-expectation; used only when reporting the source, bridged in def:p15-w02c-p15-001-chebyshev-names.
a, b, c, theta, Q, D, theta_pm; q; iota, delta, x_k, I_k, s_n, t_n, J_k: local to their theorems and annex proofs.

mathbb U, Omega_U: same meaning as the registered uniform space of thm:p15-lebesgue-unit-interval; check.py reports mathbb U as registered only in other scopes elsewhere in P15, so the lead may prefer to widen that registered row rather than merge a scoped row.

dG(x), mu_G: extends the registered dF, dG row of P15 convolution-gamma-normal (probability measures only) to any Stieltjes measure function; mu_G is the registered mu_F of P15 measure-extension with F = G. Proposed: keep the scoped intake row, or widen the convolution row's role.
# (counting measure) and sum_{i in I} f(i): scoped to this chapter; glyph # is also registered as the Hessenberg natural sum (P7) and finite-size notation (P17 social-choice) in other scopes.
Phi, Psi, Theta, M_+, s_0, delta; (i_k), delta_0: local to the four-step theorem and the counting lemma and their proofs; delta_0 is the registered Dirac law delta_c with c = 0.
bib: No new keys; DurrettPTEAuthor2019 already in handbook.bib. No intake bib written.
